| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="kafka-*"  span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="kafka-*" resource="cpu" container="kafka"  span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="connect-*"  span=1m
| streamstats current=f window=1 global=f last(value) as prev_value last(_time) as prev_time
| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())
| append [
| mstats sum(_value) as capacity WHERE index=cfk_metrics metric_name="kube_pod_container_resource_limits" namespace="confluent" env="$env$" cluster="$cluster$" pod="connect-*" resource="cpu" container="connect"  span=1m
]
| stats latest(used) as used latest(capacity) as capacity
| eval value=round(used/capacity*100,2)

| eval used=if(isnotnull(prev_value) AND (_time-prev_time)>0, (value-prev_value)/(_time-prev_time), null())

]

title: Enterprise Confluent Observability (Tier 1/2/3)
description: Three-tier cross-cutting view of the CFK deployment: Tier 1 infrastructure (per-component CPU/memory/JVM heap/GC across Kafka, Connect, Schema Registry, Control Center, KRaft Controller pods), Tier 2 platform/protocol health (controller/partition state, broker saturation, P99 request latency, KRaft quorum, Connect task status, Schema Registry leadership), and Tier 3 business/pipeline outcome (topic throughput, consumer lag, connector data quality, sink latency, source production rate, topic data volume). ksqlDB and REST Proxy panels have been excluded per scope.
